lines.t: Yeah, I been wired to the grid, scrolling every phantom high,
Trying to fix a soul‑deep wound with a surface vibe.
I called it love, called it purpose, called it legacy,
But the more I fed the want, the more it emptied me.
You stepped back, let the silence hit my armor plate,
Let the crutches snap, had to feel my own weight.
Stumbled hard in the dark, heard my ego break,
Every mask hit the floor in the afterquake.
In the static of my doubts, You were still that sound,
Gravity of mercy pulling galaxies around.
You let me fall, not to end, but to finally see,
All the props I built were chains; what I need is Thee.
All these wants in my chest like a thousand suns,
But only One fire burns when the music’s done.
Most needful, what’s most needful…
It’s You.
I’ve been chasing every signal in this neon sky,
But every star goes dark when Your wave goes by.
All my wants feel loud ‘til Your whisper speaks,
Every false light fades when You touch that need.
Turn the volume of my hunger to Your frequency,
Let the cosmos bow low when You look at me.
I don’t want more noise, I just want Your lead,
Strip the world from my veins, fill the core of my need.
Needful, needful, strip me, free me, fill this void completely.
Needful, needful, less of my illusion, more of You to keep me.
Every voice in my circle got a different plan,
“Get the bag, get a name, be your own right hand.”
But my faith ain’t meant to hang on a human frame,
When the crowd falls quiet, will You know my name?
You’ve been calling in the night like a beacon flare,
Telling me to drop the weights that I love to wear.
Family, ministry, even self‑care dreams,
Good gifts turn gods when they run my schemes.
You keep asking what’s first when the lights go low,
What’s the one well I draw from when my heartbeat slows?
In the mirror of Your gaze, all my layers peel,
What I thought I had to keep is the thing You heal.
All these wants in my chest like a thousand suns,
But only One fire burns when the music’s done.
Most needful, what’s most needful…
It’s You.
I’ve been chasing every signal in this neon sky,
But every star goes dark when Your wave goes by.
All my wants feel loud ‘til Your whisper speaks,
Every false light fades when You touch that need.
Turn the volume of my hunger to Your frequency,
Let the cosmos bow low when You look at me.
I don’t want more noise, I just want Your lead,
Strip the world from my veins, fill the core of my need.
You say, “Let go of the orbit that’s killing you slow,
Cut ties with the world you’re too scared to let go.”
Empty hands, open heart, that’s the door You choose,
Overflow from the throne in the place I lose.
Service like starlight, sacrifice like flame,
Trust in the silence when You hide Your face.
Even when You step back just to draw me near,
I will rush through the night ‘til Your voice is clear.
You tuned my lack like a laser through my brittle pride,
Every crack that I hid, You refused to hide.
Exposed my fake “needs” built on old war scars,
Turned my broken expectations into guiding stars.
Now I know when the pressure hits, it’s a holy cue,
Not a sign You’re gone, it’s a pull to You.
When the banquet shuts down and the props all fall,
You remain that one feast, one call, one All.
So I sever every tether to this passing dust,
Let the galaxies burn out, still in You I trust.
From the edge of the void to the crystal sea,
Every pulse in my chest screams, “You’re what I need.”
I’ve been chasing every signal in this neon sky,
But every star goes dark when Your wave goes by.
All my wants feel loud ‘til Your whisper speaks,
Every false light fades when You touch that need.
Turn the volume of my hunger to Your frequency,
Let the cosmos bow low when You look at me.
I don’t want more noise, I just want Your lead,
Strip the world from my veins, fill the core of my need.
Needful, needful, strip me, free me, fill this void completely.
Needful, needful, less of my illusion, more of You to keep me.
Most needful, most needful, You alone, I believe, I believe.
